title: Watch a Band Perform the Sound Effects from Pink Floyd’s “Money,” Using  a Money Counter, Torn Sheets of Paper & More
content: When Pink Floyd recorded “Money” in 1972, Roger Waters spliced into the opening moments the sounds of cash registers, tearing paper, and jingling coins. Half a century later, the German drummer Sina Doering and her band performed those sounds live, using a bowl of loose change, a toy register, a money counter, and a sheet […]
